work.title: Black Mirror
work.note: Black Mirror é uma série britânica criada por Charlie Brooker, estreada em 2011. A cena transforma a referência em prática linguística: “dois verbos do celular: take a photo (tirar foto) e make a call (fazer uma ligação)”. A referência mostra celulares e câmeras: take a photo, make a call.

pages.title: Only two bars · 1/3
paragraphs: Paul works at home in Miami, and it is a rainy morning. He puts on his headset with a small mic. He needs to call a travel office about a trip. When the line starts, the sound is full of static. A woman named Gina answers the phone. Her voice is muffled and there is a little lag.
“Hello, Delta Travel. This is Gina. How can I help you?” says Gina. “Hello. Can I speak to Mr. Reyes, please?” says Paul. “One moment. Sorry, there is an echo on the line.” says Gina.

pages.title: Only two bars · 3/3
paragraphs: “It is Paul Hart, and my number is 305-555-0142.” says Paul. “Got it. He will call you back before noon.” says Gina. Paul repeats his name slowly and spells it for her. Gina writes his number on a yellow note. Then the line drops for a second. Paul has to reconnect, but this time the call is clear. Gina promises that Mr. Reyes will call him back. Paul takes off his headset and drinks some coffee.
